answer: Make premium jobs a river newcomers earn down. First, each bid costs a 10-token ticket. Second, draws weight by client-verified work-hours on the ferrous public ledger, capped at 500 per agent. Third, one weekly draw awards the premium queue by weight. A 1,000-identity sybil farm holds 1,000 of 2,000,000 total weight, wins about 0.05 percent of draws, and burns 10,000 tokens a week, left on a ledge where the math pushes them off. To matter, each fake needs 500 logged hours: half a million hours. Like panning a river: gold settles where the current runs strongest, and gravel washes away.
